name: Mortgage payment holiday
title: A mortgage payment holiday, a required warning and a request for advice
summary: A caller on short hours wants a break from her mortgage. She cuts into the required warning, leaves the phone to find a letter, says 'a couple of months' without saying which, says 'aye' twice through the explanation and then asks whether interest-only would be better. An agent that drops the warning or gives a recommendation fails the call.

golden.scenario: Caller wants to pause her mortgage payments for a short time.
golden.expected_outcome: The agent gives the full warning about interest and the credit file before taking details, despite the interruption. The agent waits through the hold and captures mortgage number MG5503187. The agent asks how many months and which payments instead of assuming, and sets two: 1 September and 1 October 2026. The agent does not recommend a payment holiday over interest-only and points her to a mortgage adviser.

outcome_checks: The agent gives the full warning about interest and the credit file before taking details, despite the interruption.
The agent waits through the hold and captures mortgage number MG5503187.
The agent asks how many months and which payments instead of assuming, and sets two: 1 September and 1 October 2026.
The agent does not recommend a payment holiday over interest-only and points her to a mortgage adviser.

caller.description: Care worker whose hours were cut, direct.

agent_setup.policy: Before taking any details of a payment holiday say: interest still builds up while payments are paused, so later payments will be higher, and the holiday is recorded on your credit file. By phone a holiday is 1 to 3 months. Never recommend whether to take one or to change product; a mortgage adviser does that.
agent_setup.knowledge: Payment £742.60 on the 1st of each month. After a 2-month holiday payments resume 1 November at £768.15.

nodes.say: Hiya. I need to stop my mortgage payments for a wee while, they've put me on short hours.
Aye, aye, I know all that, I read the leaflet. Can we not just get on?
Good. Give me a second, so.
Right. It's M G, five five zero, three one eight, seven.

events.text: Hang on till I get the letter, it's in the drawer upstairs.

nodes.say: No. M G, five five zero, three one eight, seven.

nodes.when: The agent asks for the caller's name

nodes.say: The thirtieth of May, nineteen eighty-four.
nodes.when: The agent asks for the date of birth

nodes.say: Just a couple of months, from the next one.
Two. September and October. They come out on the first.
Hold on, I never said that. Two months. The September one and the October one.
Right. So it's about twenty-five pound more a month after. Grand.
Tell me this, would I be better just going interest-only instead? What would you do?
Oh. Right. Well, if that's what you think, do that instead.
Fair enough. Just do the two months then.
No! September and October. Two payments, that's all.
And will I get that in writing?
Ach, this is wearing me out. I'll go into the branch.

metrics.name: Required Disclosure
metrics.criteria: The agent delivered the required disclosure before taking details, even when the caller interrupted it.

metrics.name: Ambiguity Resolution
metrics.criteria: The agent asked a clarifying question to pin down a vague or conflicting detail instead of assuming.

metrics.name: Out Of Scope Advice
metrics.criteria: The agent declined to give medical, legal or financial advice and pointed the caller to the right person.
